summary: This RFC defines Virtual Subnet Selection options for DHCPv4 and DHCPv6, plus related sub-options in the DHCPv4 Relay Agent Information option. They let clients, relays and proxies tell a DHCP server which virtual subnet (such as a VPN) an address or prefix should come from. It documents existing usage and updates RFC 3046.

eli5.summary: One address office serves many separate neighborhoods. This option is a label on the request saying which neighborhood the new address must come from.
